freeze_policy: frozen from the contract alone (section 6 X3 + section 10 anti-loop); no X3 model output computed or consumed at freeze time

scope.basket: fixed Dow 30 list, identical to E2 — same basket, same origins, so X3 is comparable to E1/E2 rather than a new universe
scope.origins: the same 34 quarterly origins as E1/E2
scope.primary_metric: Spearman rank correlation of origin V/P against the subsequent 36-month annualised dividend-adjusted total return
origin_sets: window_complete_18 — the subset X0 proved is not truncation-confounded; reported for both arms because a verdict on the confounded set alone would inherit the confound

success_bar.rule: an arm SUCCEEDS when its Spearman rho is positive AND its block-bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero, on the window_complete_18 set
success_bar.all_34_role: reported and required to be non-contradictory: an arm whose all_34 rho is negative while window_complete_18 is positive is recorded as REGIME_DEPENDENT rather than a clean success
success_bar.why_positive_is_required: E2's frozen rule required only beating the baseline and never required a positive relationship, so 'less negative' satisfied it. That gap is not repeated here.

oracle.definition: residual income path built from REALISED future book and earnings drawn from EDGAR filings dated after the origin — explicit look-ahead
oracle.never: never a production input; never promoted; measures the formula's ceiling only

deployable.definition: strictly facts filed on or before the origin, earliest filed value per fiscal period so restatements cannot leak backwards, plus a pre-declared mean-reversion rule for the forward path
deployable.mean_reversion_rule: ROE fades linearly from the origin's trailing realised ROE toward the constituent's own trailing 5-year median ROE over the forecast horizon; declared here, before any result, and not tuned afterwards
deployable.no_consensus_available: the repo holds no per-constituent analyst consensus; per contract section 6 the deployable arm therefore uses historical actuals plus the stated rule, and the limitation is disclosed rather than worked around

anti_loop.representative_value: V is the hull midpoint, unchanged from E1/E2 — X0 showed the endpoints disagree (sp500 mid -0.036, low +0.114, high -0.146) and switching after seeing that would be fitting to result
